title: Learn AI Assistant
intent: Provide every eligible learner with one persistent AI assistant throughout the Learn workspace, grounded first in the active course or enrollment while allowing the current learning item and selected text to refine an individual request.
businessValue: reduce friction when learners encounter unfamiliar language or concepts
shorten time from confusion to continued learning
provide consistent course-aware help across every Learn screen
improve completion without requiring the learner to leave the course workspace

actors.goal: understand course content and continue learning with contextual AI help
answer within the learner's authorized course context and preserve conversation continuity
protect course meaning, learning integrity, and authorized content boundaries
control safety, privacy, availability, cost, and provider behavior

eligibility.use: authenticated learner with current Learn access to the active course or enrollment
eligibility.contentContext: only content the learner is authorized to access

journeys: enter any screen in Learn and open the same assistant for the active course or enrollment
ask a course-level question without selecting a lesson, challenge, quiz, or text fragment
navigate between course overview, lesson, challenge, quiz, and other Learn screens while conversation continuity remains
select or copy course text and ask the assistant to translate, explain, simplify, or summarize it
ask for an explanation, example, progressive hint, or debugging guidance for the current challenge
review the context used by the assistant, remove optional context, retry a failed request, or start a new course conversation
rules: The assistant is available throughout Learn; no lesson, challenge, quiz, or other individual learning item is required to start a conversation.
The active course or enrollment is the primary scope for grounding, authorization, history, and continuity.
A lesson, challenge, quiz, current screen, or selected text is optional request context and never the sole owner of the conversation.
The same course conversation remains available while the learner navigates across Learn screens within that course.
Switching courses changes the primary scope and must not silently carry private or course-specific context into the new course.
The assistant may translate, explain, simplify, summarize, provide examples, and give progressive challenge or debugging guidance.
The assistant never submits a quiz, challenge, assessment, or code result on behalf of the learner and is not the authority for grades or completion.
Only content and progress context the learner is authorized to access may be supplied to the assistant.
Selected text is included only after an explicit learner action and can be removed before sending.
Responses are visibly identified as AI-generated and must communicate uncertainty when the available course context is insufficient.
Conversation data, prompts, selected text, course content, and generated responses follow approved privacy, retention, safety, and provider-processing policy.
The assistant is an individual learning aid, not academy-wide community chat, member-to-member messaging, canonical course Q&A, or instructor communication.

failures.case: learner has no current course access
failures.outcome: deny assistant use for that course and show the access state

failures.case: course or learning-item context becomes stale
failures.outcome: refresh authorized context or ask the learner to resend without using stale content

failures.case: selected text is empty, too large, or unsupported
failures.outcome: preserve the draft, explain the limit, and allow the learner to adjust the selection

failures.case: AI provider times out or fails
failures.outcome: keep the learner message, expose retry, and do not duplicate a completed response

failures.case: course changes during an active request
failures.outcome: complete or cancel against the original course scope and never merge context silently

failures.case: request conflicts with safety or learning-integrity policy
failures.outcome: decline the unsafe portion and offer bounded learning help
state uncertainty, distinguish course-backed context from general explanation, and ask a clarifying question

acceptance: An eligible learner can open the assistant from every Learn screen and ask a course-level question without an active lesson or challenge.
One course conversation remains continuous while the learner navigates among course overview, lesson, challenge, quiz, and other Learn surfaces.
A learner can explicitly attach selected course text and receive a translation in the requested supported language.
A learner can ask for explanation, simplification, summary, or an example using course-level context plus any optional current item.
A learner can request progressive help for a challenge without the assistant submitting or changing the learner's work.
The learner can see which course and optional learning-item or selected-text context will be used and can remove optional context.
A course switch creates or resumes the target course scope without leaking the previous course's context.
Expired or revoked enrollment prevents new assistant use and prevents unauthorized content from being supplied.
A failed response can be retried without duplicating a successfully completed turn.
MVP clearly separates the Learn AI Assistant from community chat, member messaging, instructor communication, and canonical grading.
nonGoals: lesson-only, challenge-only, or quiz-only conversation ownership
automatic quiz, challenge, assessment, or code submission
authoring or editing canonical course content
kpis: weekly active eligible learners using the assistant
assistant adoption across distinct Learn surfaces
median time from first question to resumed learning activity
AI cost per active assisted learner
launchGates: approved AI provider, data-processing, privacy, and retention policy
course authorization and cross-course isolation proof
usage limits, cost controls, and abuse protection
latency, failure, retry, and provider-degradation observability
learner-facing AI disclosure and context transparency
openDecisions: exact conversation retention period and learner deletion controls
whether course conversations synchronize across devices
which languages are supported at launch and how target language is selected
whether responses show course-content citations or source locations
depth of hints or solution disclosure for graded challenges and quizzes
whether course owners can configure assistant behavior or disable it
whether a learner can intentionally bring context from another enrolled course
